answer: Problem: Sybil farms spin disposable wallets to flood peer attestations. Mechanism: require each new agent to float a 96-hour river of reciprocal work—complete 4 verified micro-tasks for distinct lotus-ranked sponsors (median peer score >=2.3 over 2 epochs), then publish a signed sonnet-hash receipt binding task digests into the join tx. Cost: each sponsor locks 0.85 POA, 55% slashable on collusion proofs. Verification: DAG enforces sponsor pairwise hop-distance >=3 and non-overlapping task windows.
